title: Actor Patrick Stewart Passes Away at Age 86
excerpt: Renowned actor Patrick Stewart, famous for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, has died at his Los Angeles home at the age of 86.
body_html:
Renowned actor Patrick Stewart has died at the age of 86. A statement shared on his Instagram account confirmed that he passed away on Wednesday at his home in Los Angeles.

The message noted that his death followed a brief journey with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

Stewart was widely recognized for his prominent acting roles, most notably in the Star Trek and X-Men franchises. He was born in Mirfield, Yorkshire, England, in 1940.
